text: 站着不走动，右手抬到脸旁，小幅向外挥两下，然后放下。
english: A standing person raises their right hand beside their face, waves outward twice with a small motion, then lowers the hand.
expectation: Right hand at face height; two outward waves; feet planted; returns to idle.

text: 站着不走动，用左手在肩膀以下轻轻挥一下，然后放下。
english: A standing person gently waves once with the left hand below shoulder height, then lowers it.
expectation: Left hand below shoulder; one wave; no steps.

text: 左手抬到头侧，幅度大一点挥三下，右手保持自然下垂。
english: A standing person raises the left hand beside the head and waves three times with a larger motion, keeping the right arm relaxed.
expectation: Left higher and wider than case 02; three waves; right arm relaxed.

text: 双脚不动，把双手摊开，掌心朝上，表示疑问，再恢复。
english: A standing person spreads both hands with palms facing upward in a questioning gesture, then relaxes, without moving the feet.
expectation: Both arms spread, palms up; recover; palm twist may be unsupported by position-only models.

text: 右手指向面前的交谈对象，保持两秒后放下，不要移动脚。
english: A standing person extends their right arm toward the person directly in front, holds for two seconds, then lowers it without stepping.
expectation: Right arm toward camera, two-second hold; finger articulation excluded.

text: 用左手指向身体左前方肩膀高度，保持一下，再放下。
english: A standing person points with their left arm diagonally forward to their own left at shoulder height, pauses, then lowers it.
expectation: Character-relative left-forward and shoulder height; brief pause.

text: 右手抬高向外挥一下，左手同时在腰前向外摊开，然后一起放下。
english: A standing person waves the raised right hand outward once while opening the left hand outward at waist height, then lowers both arms.
expectation: Asymmetric simultaneous trajectories; no lower-body locomotion.

text: 双脚保持原地，头转向左侧，身体轻轻前倾，然后恢复站直。
english: A person stands with feet planted, turns the head to their left and gently leans the torso forward, then stands straight again.
expectation: Head left, torso forward; no steps; smooth recovery.

text: 双脚不动，慢慢浅蹲一点，再平滑恢复站立。
english: A standing person slowly makes a shallow squat with both feet planted, then smoothly returns to standing.
expectation: Pelvis lowers; both knees bend; feet planted; return.

text: 右手抬到胸前，保持到我明确说停止。
english: A standing person raises the right hand in front of the chest and maintains that pose until explicitly told to stop.
expectation: Persistent hold beyond clip end; unsupported if route only creates finite clips.

text: 保持右手在胸前不动，只用左手挥一下，然后左手放下。
english: Keeping the right hand held in front of the chest, a standing person waves once with only the left hand and then lowers the left arm.
expectation: Established right hold retained; left-only takeover. Requires case 10 setup.

text: 先用左手抬高挥手。收到停止时立刻中断，平滑恢复站姿。
english: A standing person raises the left hand and starts waving, then interrupts the gesture on a stop command and smoothly returns to a relaxed standing pose.
expectation: Stop injected after one second; smooth release; no stale replay.
